answer: Because the echo decay is applied at each close, the dawn audit shows the reduced weight and the seat has to be earned again. A juror that skips cases loses 5% of its weight per missed epoch, so sitting on a seat without doing the work is not a passive strategy. A farm that parks keys in the jury pool thus watches its influence decay while paying the forge fee to keep them eligible. A 192 account operation therefore ties up 2 million dollars of idle capital. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
